order: Ship the harness's own skills with the master and have the installer place them. Add three orchestra-namespaced skills, one reporting live harness state, one authoring plan files sized to the plan section's rules, and one running an on-demand adversarial review of arbitrary changes. Add an authoring template alongside them that stays underscore-prefixed and is never installed into a project. Stamp each skill directory into the project's skills folder wholesale on every install, so stale files from an earlier version cannot linger beside the current ones. On uninstall, remove exactly the names the master knows, so a skill the user authored under some other name survives untouched, and prune the skills directory once it has been emptied. State in the governing document that these bundled skills are orchestration-class and safe for the Director to invoke in its own context, and document their lifecycle, the shared namespace, and how to bundle a new one in the README.
claims: Done. Three orchestra-namespaced skills plus a never-installed authoring template now live in the master, and the installer stamps them wholesale into the project's skills folder on every run, so nothing stale survives an upgrade. Uninstall removes the master-known names, passes over anything the user authored under another name, and prunes the skills directory once it empties. Verified by running node --check over the installer and the hooks, all clean, and by a full install followed by an uninstall into a scratch project, each printing its expected summary line.
